## Direct Answer: What Is the Winning Strategy for Maharashtra Police Bharti 2026?

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> **Core Fact**: To secure final selection in the Maharashtra Police Bharti (Constable / Driver / SRPF), candidates must score at least **42+ out of 50 marks in the Physical Efficiency Test (Ground)** to qualify for the written exam, followed by **88+ out of 100 marks in the Written Examination**. Balancing morning physical stamina drills with disciplined afternoon Marathi grammar and reasoning studies is the non-negotiable formula for success.

Maharashtra Police recruitment (महाराष्ट्र पोलीस भरती) is one of the most prestigious state law-enforcement drives in India, offering dynamic careers across **District Police, Mumbai City Police, State Reserve Police Force (SRPF), Bandsman, and Police Driver Constables**. With over 15 lakh youth competing across Maharashtra's 36 districts, success demands a coordinated plan that simultaneously prepares your body for grueling physical trials and trains your mind for rapid objective testing.

---

## Maharashtra Police Bharti Selection Stages & Mark Architecture

The recruitment process is executed in two decisive competitive stages:

### Stage 1: Physical Efficiency Test (PET / Ground) – 50 Marks
Candidates must score a minimum of 50% marks (25 marks) on the ground to be shortlisted for the written examination at a ratio of 1:10 based on merit:

| Event / Physical Drill | Male Candidates Standard | Female Candidates Standard | Maximum Marks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Long Distance Endurance Run** | 1600 Meters (Under 5 mins 10 secs = 20 Marks) | 800 Meters (Under 2 mins 50 secs = 20 Marks) | **20 Marks** |
| **Short Distance Speed Sprint** | 100 Meters Sprint (Under 11.5 secs = 15 Marks) | 100 Meters Sprint (Under 14.0 secs = 15 Marks) | **15 Marks** |
| **Shot Put (गोळा फेक)** | 7.26 Kg Shot Put (8.50+ Meters = 15 Marks) | 4.00 Kg Shot Put (6.00+ Meters = 15 Marks) | **15 Marks** |
| **Total Ground Benchmark** | **Target: 44+ Marks** | **Target: 42+ Marks** | **50 Marks Total** |

### Stage 2: Written Examination (लेखी परीक्षा) – 100 Marks (90 Minutes)
An OMR-based / offline objective test with no negative marking consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions:

| Subject Domain | Questions | Marks | Mark Weightage Graph | Core Focus Areas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **मराठी व्याकरण (Marathi Grammar)** | 25 Questions | 25 Marks | [BAR:25%:Marathi Grammar] | वर्णविचार, संधी, समास, प्रयोग, समानार्थी व विरुद्धार्थी शब्द, म्हणी |
| **अंकगणित (Quantitative Aptitude / Maths)** | 25 Questions | 25 Marks | [BAR:25%:Mathematics] | लसावी-मसावी, टक्केवारी, नफा-तोटा, सरळव्याज, काळ-काम-वेग, रेल्वे गणित |
| **बुद्धिमत्ता चाचणी (Reasoning Ability)** | 25 Questions | 25 Marks | [BAR:25%:Reasoning] | संख्या मालिका, सांकेतिक भाषा, नातेसंबंध, दिशा, वेन आकृत्या, घड्याळ |
| **सामान्य ज्ञान व चालू घडामोडी (GK & Current Affairs)** | 25 Questions | 25 Marks | [BAR:25%:GK & Current Affairs] | महाराष्ट्राचा इतिहास, भूगोल, पंचायत राज, पोलीस प्रशासन, चालू घडामोडी |
| **Total Composite Score** | **100 Questions** | **100 Marks** | **[BAR:100%:Total Test]** | **Duration: 90 Minutes (Target: 90+ Marks)** |

## The Topper-Recommended Booklist for Maharashtra Police Bharti

Sticking to standard, proven Marathi-medium textbooks is the fastest way to master the 100-mark written test without syllabus deviations:

| Subject Domain | Standard Recommended Book | Author / Publisher | Why It Is Crucial |
|---|---|---|---|
| **मराठी व्याकरण** | *सुगम मराठी व्याकरण व लेखन* | मो. रा. वाळंबे (M.R. Walambe) / बाळासाहेब शिंदे (Balasaheb Shinde) | The absolute gold standard for Marathi grammar; covers every nuance of प्रयोग, समास, and शब्दसिद्धी. |
| **अंकगणित (Maths)** | *संपूर्ण अंकगणित* | पंढरीनाथ राणे (Pandharinath Rane) / नितीन महाले (Nitin Mahale) | Step-by-step shortcuts tailored specifically for Maharashtra state police and clerk numerical patterns. |
| **बुद्धिमत्ता चाचणी** | *अचूक बुद्धिमत्ता चाचणी* | अनिल अंकलगी (Anil Ankalgi) / सचिन ढवळे (Sachin Dhavale) | Contains crystal-clear explanations of non-verbal series, clock calculations, and seating arrangements. |
| **सामान्य ज्ञान (GK Mega Guide)** | *स्पर्धा परीक्षा ठोकळा (Thokla)* | एकनाथ पाटील (Eknath Patil 'Tatya') | The indispensable bible for Maharashtra GK, covering history of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, state geography, and local administration. |
| **चालू घडामोडी (Current Affairs)** | *लक्ष्यवेध चालू घडामोडी / देवा जाधवर* | डॉ. शैलेंद्र मस्के / देवा जाधवर | Concise quarterly summaries of state government schemes, sports awards, and Maharashtra police achievements. |
| **PYQ Solved Papers (प्रश्नपत्रिका संच)** | *पोलीस भरती 572 / 30,000 जम्बो प्रश्नपत्रिका संच* | सिद्धेश्वर हडबे (भारतीय प्रकाशन) | Indispensable collection of actual police papers across Mumbai, Pune, Thane, Nagpur, and rural district units. |

## 75-Day Dual-Action Training Blueprint

### Phase 1: Days 1 to 25 — Stamina Building & Basic Grammar Rules
- **Ground Routine (Morning 05:30 AM – 07:30 AM)**: Focus on aerobic lung capacity. Run 3 to 4 km at a steady jogging pace 4 days a week to build cardiovascular endurance. Practice wrist pushups and core abdominal exercises for shot put power.
- **Written Study (10:00 AM – 05:00 PM)**:  
  - *Marathi*: Finish Sandhi (संधी), Samas (समास), and Prayog (प्रयोग) from Balasaheb Shinde.  
  - *Maths*: Practice basic calculations, fractions, percentage, and ratio-proportion formulas.  
  - *GK*: Read Maharashtra Geography (Western Ghats, river systems of Godavari, Krishna, Tapi).

### Phase 2: Days 26 to 55 — Speed Drills & Technical Shot-Put Mastery
- **Ground Routine**: Introduce interval training. 4 x 400-meter sprints at target 1600m race pace. Dedicate 45 minutes daily to the 7.26 kg shot put technique (focus on 45-degree release angle, glide stance, and hip push).
- **Written Study**:  
  - *Reasoning*: Practice 40 questions daily on coding-decoding, calendar, and clock problems.  
  - *Maths*: Master Train speed calculations, Time & Work, and Profit & Loss.  
  - *Current Affairs*: Memorize top state awards (Maharashtra Bhushan), sports medalists, and Maharashtra cabinet ministers.

### Phase 3: Days 56 to 75 — Ground Mock Simulations & Full Written Papers
- **Ground Routine**: Measure actual stopwatch timings on a standard 400m synthetic or mud track every Saturday. Aim for sub-5:10 mins in 1600m and 8.5+ meters in shot put.
- **Written Study**: Solve 1 previous year district police paper (100 questions) under strict 90-minute examination conditions daily.
- **Error Log**: Mark repeated grammatical errors and confusing reasoning questions; re-read the specific rules from your notebook every evening.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### Q1: Can I appear for both District Police Constable and SRPF in the same Bharti cycle?
Yes, but you must submit separate online applications for each specific unit (e.g., District Police Constable, SRPF, Police Driver, or Railway Police) as per the official government notification guidelines.

### Q2: Is there any negative marking in the Maharashtra Police written exam?
No. The Maharashtra Police Constable written examination does not have negative marking. Candidates are strongly advised to attempt all 100 questions to maximize their aggregate score.

### Q3: What is the minimum qualifying height for Male and Female candidates?
For male candidates (General & Reserved), the minimum height requirement is 165 cm, with a chest measurement of 79 cm unexpanded and 84 cm expanded (minimum 5 cm expansion). For female candidates, the minimum height requirement is 158 cm.

### Q4: How can I improve my Shot Put (गोळा फेक) distance to cross 8.5 meters?
Distance in shot put comes from your lower body drive, hips, and core rotation, not just arm strength. Focus on squats, pushups, and explosive power drills. Maintain a 45-degree trajectory during release rather than throwing too high or too flat.
